data.narrative:
Hadean is a Series B-stage defense and security technology company that has raised $40M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage. The private peer set includes Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses Hadean's $40M total raised as a proxy base valuation and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-subsequent-stage progression, yielding $76M. The peer-median method benchmarks against 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.0B and a range spanning $300M to $3.0B. These two approaches produce a wide spread reflecting material differences in company maturity, customer concentration, and market traction within the defense technology vertical.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $65M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $538M. The 17x spread between low and high estimates reflects genuine uncertainty around Hadean's relative positioning within its peer cohort. Key sensitivities include proof of revenue traction relative to Stage B peers, customer concentration in government versus commercial segments, and the degree to which the company has achieved product-market fit in its target vertical.
